# Pwrschdlr

> Pwrschdlr ("power scheduler" without the vowels) is a free, open-source (MIT) shutdown timer for Windows 11 by Luka Stojiljković. It shuts down, restarts, sleeps, hibernates or signs out of a PC after a delay or at a time of day, shows the countdown, and opens a warning before the end so the user can cancel or postpone.

Key facts:

- One timer, set for a delay (presets from 15 minutes to 4 hours) or a time of day, up to 23 hours 59 minutes away. Daylight saving time is handled.
- The timer keeps running when the app is closed: a per-user scheduled task opens Pwrschdlr 30 seconds, 1, 2 or 5 minutes before the end, and the warning stays on top.
- A timer that ran out while the PC was off, asleep or signed out is reported, never run late.
- Requires Windows 11, or Windows 10 version 1809 or later, x64. Tested on Windows 11. English UI.
- Installs for the current user without administrator rights. Collects no data and doesn't connect to the internet.
- Verified by 55 unit tests, UI Automation on Windows 11 and a silent install and uninstall in CI.
